name: To Ironforge for Yagyin's Digest
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
The Tablet tells much.  But not enough!  Not nearly enough!

There is a book, a digest that Yagyin wrote in ages past.  The ... people I fled ... they keep this book in many places.  And their most learned study it.  It holds vast knowledge.  Knowledge to protect us!

Go to Gerrig Bonegrip.  He is in a shop in Ironforge, in the Forlorn Cavern.  Show him this sigil and he'll think you one of them.  Ask him for Yagyin's Digest ... and bring it to me!
narrative.objectives: Give the Sigil of the Hammer to Gerrig Bonegrip in the Forlorn Cavern of Ironforge.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Oh. Greetings, brother.

And praise to the dwellers beneath.
narrative.requestItemsText:
Hello. Welcome to my shop, but watch what you touch.

Knowledge can be deadly.
